associations.rationale: The displayed type only introduces commutant as a real endomorphism subalgebra and does not expose equivariance, dimension, or division.
The type directly states that every nonzero element of the commutant is a unit, giving the division-algebra property.
The type directly states that the real finrank of the commutant is four.
The equivalence directly identifies membership in the commutant with commuting with every SU(2) action, hence with equivariant endomorphisms.
